# Document map

**Kind:** derived · **Generated by:** `node scripts/_doc_map.cjs` · **Never hand-edit.**

Every document under `docs/`, with the kind it declares for itself. Generated by
reading each document's own front matter — so it cannot disagree with them.

Generated 2026-09-27. **54 documents.**

---

## 1. By kind

| Kind | Count | What it means |
|---|---:|---|
| **derived** | 2 | Generated from the tree. Never hand-edited; regenerating is the only way to change it. |
| **dated** | 27 | Hand-written, carries `Last verified:` with a date and a commit. Goes stale **visibly**. |
| **living** | 11 | Hand-written, asserted against the tree by a check. Fails the suite when it drifts. |
| **index** | 9 | A domain's front door. Navigation, not content. |
| **template** | 5 | A shape to copy. Not a document about this project. |

A **living** claim written as if it were **dated** is the defect the whole system
exists to prevent — see [`conventions.md` §2](./conventions.md#2-declare-the-documents-kind).

## 3. Adding a document

1. **Declare its kind** in the front matter. A document with no kind fails
   `node scripts/_doc_map.cjs --check`, and therefore CI.
2. **List it in [`../README.md`](../README.md)** — the human index. `tests/docs.mjs`
   asserts every document appears there exactly once.
3. **Regenerate this file**: `node scripts/_doc_map.cjs`.
